steps.code:
# Parse file paths and reorganize
import os

# Get the list of files again (already have files_only)
for file_path in files_only:
    # Extract base name
    base_name = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = base_name.split('__', 1)
    # Split rest on last '.' to get file_name and extension
    file_name, extension = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    # New directory name is file_name
    new_dir = f"{meetings_dir}{file_name}/"
    # Create directory if not exists
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # New file path
    new_file_path = f"{new_dir}{date_part}.{extension}"
    # Move file
    move_resp = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=new_file_path)
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {new_file_path}: {move_resp}")
